verdicts.title: Recent advances on the log-rank conjecture in communication complexity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The log-rank conjecture is one of the fundamental open problems in communication complexity. It speculates that the deterministic communication complexity of any two-party function is equal to the log of the rank of its associated matrix, up to polynomial factors. Despite much research, we still know very little about this conjecture. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract surveys the log-rank conjecture relating deterministic communication complexity to log of matrix rank, but says nothing about twisted tensor product rank or a 'rank variance' measure, so it neither supports nor refutes the specific linear lower-bound claim R_tw(f) = Ω(R_var(f)).
